description:
## Goal

Transform the Standards page from a passive rule list into an actionable audit tool. Each rule should be understandable (what it checks, what files, examples) and executable (run against a specific scenario).

## Current State

The Standards page shows 5 rules:
- Logo Present (warning) — checks `b.Identity.LogoPath != ""`
- Favicon Present (warning) — checks `b.Identity.FaviconPath != ""`
- Color System Defined (warning) — checks 4 colors are non-empty
- Display Name Set (error) — checks `b.Identity.DisplayName != ""`
- Typography Defined (info) — checks heading + body fonts

Each rule shows only: name, one-line description, severity badge. No detail on what files are involved, what passing/failing looks like, or how to fix violations.

## Implementation

### Expandable Rule Cards
Click/tap a rule to expand and show:
- **What it checks:** Detailed explanation of the validation logic
- **Target files:** Which files in a scenario this rule inspects or expects to be modified (e.g., `ui/public/manifest.json`, `ui/src/styles/brand.css`, `ui/public/logo.png`)
- **Passing example:** What a compliant scenario looks like (code snippet or visual)
- **Failing example:** What a non-compliant scenario looks like
- **How to fix:** Step-by-step instructions to resolve the violation
- **Severity explanation:** Why this rule is warning/error/info level

### Per-Rule Execution
- Each rule card gets a "Check Scenario" button
- Opens a small inline form: scenario name input + "Run" button
- Calls the audit endpoint for just that rule
- Shows pass/fail result inline with specific details

### Batch Execution
- "Scan All Rules" button at the top of the Standards page
- Scenario name input → runs all rules at once
- Results displayed per-rule with pass/fail badges
- Summary: X/5 rules passing, overall compliance score

### API Changes
- Enhance `GET /api/v1/standards` to return additional metadata per rule:
  - `target_files[]` — glob patterns of files the rule checks
  - `passing_example` — code/config snippet showing compliance
  - `failing_example` — code/config snippet showing violation
  - `fix_instructions` — markdown remediation guide
- Add `POST /api/v1/audit/evaluate/{scenario}?rule={ruleId}` — single-rule evaluation

## Key Files

- Standards handler: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/handlers/standards.go` (rule definitions)
- Standards page: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/pages/StandardsPage.tsx`
- Audit handler: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/handlers/` (EvaluateScenario)
- Scanner page: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/pages/ScannerPage.tsx` (reference for scan UX)

title: Add Detailed Rule Documentation and Per-Rule Execution to Standards Page
